text: Najib isn't a supporting character, he's the whole pitch. A real Syrian vouching for Tbone gives him access, approval, legitimacy — that's what makes the donation button work. And yet Najib says absolutely nothing the entire video, he just waves around like an NPC, like his only job that day was to show up and get photographed next to Tbone at the Sea of Galilee. That's affinity fraud — manufacture the community's endorsement, then cash the check nobody can verify. And behind the account claiming to be Najib, not one named human being.

If you didn't have the stock photo Tbone used for the fake, how else could you know this is a gen-AI fake? The Sea of Galilee sits 700 feet below sea level. There is no point on it where the far embankment isn't visible — and it's absent from the image Tbone lifted.

So where does that leave you with Najib? There is no Syrian named Najib, who posed at the Sea of Galilee, because it's physically impossible for the lake to stop in the middle of his head without a far embankment. He may have stolen an actual person's face — he does this all the time — but that's not him.
